quantities.label: Peak ground acceleration
quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.description: An intensity measure at one bridge. A hazard function producing it on the Bridge plate feeds any fragility function consuming the same IM; a GMM or ShakeMap declared with "{imt}" produces whichever IM its parameters name.

quantities.label: Observed spectral acceleration, T = 1.0 s, 5% damping
quantities.description: A measurement of SA(1.0) at one bridge, with error. Observing it conditions the bridge's SA(1.0) softly, where observing SA(1.0) itself would fix it.

quantities.label: Edge open to traffic
quantities.description: False closed, True open (state indices 0 and 1). The edge state the system functions read.

quantities.label: System event survives
quantities.description: Fail or Survival (state indices 0 and 1), by the event's own definition: a travel time within its tolerance of the intact network's, or a max flow at or above its threshold. The binary node a system-reliability analysis is about.
